note: Both sets hallucinate a linear-stiffness value of 7,000 N·m/rad which is not present in the text. Set A incorrectly claims the drivetrain's natural frequency is 5% critical, whereas the text states 5% is the structural-damping ratio; Set B correctly binds the 5% to the damping ratio. Set B also uses slightly more precise entity names for the generator inertia compared to Set A's garbled 'generator speed shaft'.
